summary: BubbleSelect dropdown fix verified - All 3 new job card types (oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, solicitud_servicio) are now selectable. Job-specific fields (Rango Salarial, Tipo de Contrato, Modalidad, Experiencia, Urgencia, Fecha Límite, Requisitos, Beneficios) appear correctly when selecting job card types.
critical_code_review_comments: BubbleSelect fix applied: Changed from onClick/onTouchEnd to onMouseDown/onTouchStart events
Overlay z-index changed from 9999 to 9998 (below options container at 10000)
Added data-testid attributes for better testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: BubbleSelect component is now fully working. All 11 card types selectable including the 3 new job card types. Job-specific fields render correctly when selecting oferta_trabajo, busqueda_personal, or solicitud_servicio.

bubble_select_dropdown.details: Dropdown opens, scrolls, and allows selection of all 11 card types

oferta_trabajo_selection.details: Can select 'Oferta de Trabajo' and job fields appear

job_specific_fields.details: All 8/8 job-specific fields visible and interactable

changes: Line 114: Changed overlay z-index from 9999 to 9998
Lines 115-124: Changed onClick to onMouseDown and onTouchEnd to onTouchStart on overlay
Lines 138-139: Added onMouseDown and onTouchStart stopPropagation on options container
Lines 150-159: Changed onClick to onMouseDown and onTouchEnd to onTouchStart on option buttons
Line 148: Added data-testid attribute for each option
fix_applied.root_cause: The original onClick/onTouchEnd events were being intercepted by the overlay before the option button could process them. Using onMouseDown/onTouchStart ensures the events fire in the correct order.
